p: Of Shoshannim, read Ps 45:1.
waters are come in unto my: David shows by the waters the great dangers he was in, out of which God delivered him.
standing: No stable firmness to settle my feet.
eyes fail while I wait for: Though his senses failed him, yet his faith was constant and encouraged him still to pray.
wrongfully: Condemning me as guilty.
took not away: They judged me a thief, though innocent, and gave my goods to others, as though I had stolen them.
foolishness: Though I am guilty toward you, yet I am innocent toward them.
my sake: Do not let my evil entreaty of the enemy be an opportunity for the faithful to fall from you.
For the zeal of thine house: When I saw your enemies claim your Name in mouth only, and in their life deny the same, your Holy Spirit thrust me forward to reprove them and defend your glory.
wept: My zeal moved me to lament and pray for my salvation.
sit in the gate speak against: The more he sought to win them to God, the more they were against him both the poor and the rich.
acceptable time: Knowing that even though I endure trouble now, yet you have a time in which you have appointed my deliverance.
deep waters: He shows a living faith, in that he believes that God is favourable towards him when he seems to be angry and at hand when he seems to be far off.
hide not thy face from thy: Not that he feared that God would not hear him, but that care made him think that God delayed too long.
adversaries are all before thee: You see that I am beset as a sheep among many wolves.

I looked for some to take: He shows men that it is vain to put our trust in men in our great necessity, but that our comfort only depends on God: for man increases our sorrows, then diminishes them, Joh 19:29.
table become a snare before them: He desires God to execute his judgments against the reprobate, which cannot by any means be turned, Rom 11:9.
loins continually to shake: Take both judgment and power from them, Ac 1:20.
habitation be desolate: Punish not only them, but their posterity, who will be like them.
iniquity unto their iniquity: By their continuance and increasing in their sins, let it be known that they are of the reprobate.
book of the living: They who seemed by their profession to have been written in your book, yet by their fruits prove the contrary, let them be known as reprobates.
bullock that hath horns and hoofs: There is no sacrifice which God values more than thanksgiving for his benefits.
prisoners: For as he delivered his servant David, so will he do for all that are in distress and call on him.
seed also of his servants shall: Under the temporal promise of the land of Canaan, he comprehends the promise of everlasting life to the faithful and their posterity.
